text: Hello, nice to see you.Today we are going to focus on vocabulary.By the end of this period, you are expected to 1.learn and use the words and phrases in the context, 2.use history-related words to describe historic sites and express your opinions.Please get your textbooks ready.In the previous lesson, we analyzed the structure of the passage.It follows the general to specific pattern.A general introduction is given in the first paragraph, and then the passage delves into the details of the Grand Canal in different periods.Let's follow the pattern and the timeline to review the text and dig deeper.After reading the passage, how much do you know about the Grand Canal?Good, let's focus on the word extend.Here are two sentences.What does extend mean in each sentence?Match the meaning with the sentence.Extend means to cover a particular area, distance, length, or time.In the second sentence, it means to make something longer or larger.Complete the following sentences with the appropriate form of extend.Let's check the answers.We learned from the text that it was the leader of the state of Wu who came up with the idea of building a canal.Then for what reason did he do it?Due to the need to transport goods and military supplies to the northern areas of China, he opted for a longer-lasting alternative, a canal, which laid the foundation for the future longer Grand Canal.Opt for means to choose to take a particular course of action.Now please complete the sentence based on the Chinese.After graduating, she opted for a career in teaching.We can also say she opted to be a teacher.Then can you guess the antonym of opt for?Antonym means a word, meaning the opposite of another word.Yes, it's opt against.Interestingly, opt is not only a verb, but also a word root, meaning to choose.So we have option as its noun form and optional as its adjective.How about the phrase lay the foundation for?Can you use another phrase to replace this one?Maybe the basis of.The canal built in this period was the basis of the future Grand Canal.Or you can also say the future Grand Canal evolved or developed from this one.Think about this question.What will lay the foundation for your future?Your answers may vary.Here is a possible answer.Being equipped with knowledge will lay the foundation for my future.Then why did Emperor Yongle of the Ming dynasty think of using the waterway system to transport grain?Since he decided to transfer the capital from Nanjing to Beijing and had a lot of people to feed on the move, the plan he devised was to go by the waterway.Let's look at the word transfer.Please note that trans is a prefix, meaning across, beyond.So transfer means to move from one place to another.Can you think of other words having trans as the prefix?Here are some examples.Transport, transmit, transplant, translate, transcontinental.Now look at the following sentences and guess the meaning of transfer in each sentence.Trans is a prefix, meaning across, beyond.So transfer is to move from one place to another.The seriously ill patient was transferred to another hospital.Here, transfer means 转院.How can I transfer my money to his bank account?In this sentence, transfer means 转账.He transferred to Renmin University after his freshman year.In this sentence, transfer means 转学.You can transfer to Line 2, Line 4, Line 6 and Line 9 at Century Avenue Station.Here, transfer means 换乘.Number 5, rarely is the disease transferred from mother to baby.Here, transfer means 传染.Whatever the meaning, something or somebody is moved from one place to another.Please pay attention.When the word is used in passive voice, past tense and as participants, the R at the end should be doubled.Let's move on to the next question.In the Ming dynasty, the emperor appointed Chen Xuan to restore the Grand Canal.Who was Chen Xuan?What did he do?Chen Xuan, a hydraulic engineering expert, was appointed to oversee an ambitious large-scale canal project where more than 47,000 men were employed to maintain the Grand Canal.In other words, the emperor of the Ming dynasty chose Chen Xuan to oversee the project.A point means to choose somebody for a job or position of responsibility.Look at this picture and complete the sentence.About 4,000 years ago, when the Yellow River in China was troubled by floods,Dayu was appointed to lead and organize the work of water control.A point also means to arrange or decide on a time or place for doing something.For example, a date for the visit to the Summer Palace is still to be appointed.The noun form is appointment.Please translate the Chinese sentence into English.Yes, she made an appointment with her colleague to attend the oil painting exhibition.Well done.Why was Chen Xuan appointed to oversee the restoration project?Because he was a hydraulic engineering expert.Hydraulic engineering is a process ofHydraulic contains the word root hyd, which means water.Knowing the meanings of word roots helps us understand words better.The word hydrogen is a typical example.It consists of two word roots.Hydro means water, while zhen means to produce.Therefore, hydrogen is the substance we can use to produce water.And we know that if we burn hydrogen, water will be produced.Here comes the question.Do you know what the biggest hydroelectric power station in the world is?Yes, it's the Three Gorges Dam.Then what kind of person do you think Chen Xuan was?Maybe he was ambitious, because the project was really an unprecedentedly ambitious and large-scale one.Here, an ambitious project means a project needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed.While an ambitious person describes someone determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.The noun form is ambition.Can you think of other adjectives to describe Chen Xuan?I think he was a capable person since he could manage so many things at the same time so well.I think he was perseverant because overseeing such an ambitious canal project was by no means easy and needed hard work and perseverance.Well said.Here are more words you can use to describe historical figures.Responsible, reliable, creative, enterprising, tough, daring, and so on.Under Chen Xuan's supervision, the restored Grand Canal became the economic lifeline of the Ming dynasty.How about its present status?Has it lost its appeal?Obviously not.Although the railway system has expanded, the Grand Canal remains an important waterway, diverting water from the Yangtze River to the country's more arid regions.Expand means to become greater in size, number or importance.To make something greater in size, number or importance.At the beginning of today's class, we learned another word,extend.This two words share the same prefix,ex.It mainly has two meanings.First, out, out of, such as export, extract, expose, exclude, etc.The second meaning is former, such as ex-soldier, ex-colony, etc.So far, you've done a great job.Let's do some practice.Filling each blank with the appropriate form of a word from the text.You've got one minute.Time's up.Please check the answers yourself.Thank you for watching.Now that we have reviewed the text and covered the language points, it's your turn to use what you've learned to express your opinions.Here is the question.In which period was the construction of the Grand Canal the most important in your opinion?Here is one student's example answer.In which period, the leader of the State of Wu first opted for a longer alternative to transport goods and military supplies.Although it was only a small section of the Grand Canal, it laid the foundation for the future longer Grand Canal, and it was the Sui dynasty that the modern Grand Canal took shape.Later on, Chen Xuan was appointed to oversee the ambitious large-scale project, which facilitated the economic growth and cultural exchanges in the Ming dynasty.Thanks to our ancestors' wisdom, industry, and concerted efforts, the great infrastructural achievement is still benefiting us.Extending around 1,800 kilometers, it is not only connecting us geographically, but also spiritually.Brilliant idea.The Grand Canal was not built by one emperor or one dynasty, but by the joint efforts made by the Chinese people.What have been used correctly and properly to convey your opinion?For the interactive task, share with your classmates one of your favorite historical figures.Use adjectives to describe his or her personality, and use concrete examples to support your description.Search on the Internet for more information if necessary.Assignment for today.Finish the exercise on pages 41 to 44 in your student's workbook.That's all for today's class.In the next period, we will move on to grammar.See you around.
